Before you use JWTs with Amazon OpenSearch Service you must consider the following:
• Due to the size of RSA public keys in PEM formatting, we recommend using the AWS console to
conﬁgure JWT authentication and authorization.
• You must provide valid users and roles when specifying the subjects and roles ﬁelds for your
JWTs, otherwise, requests will be denied.
• OpenSearch 2.11 is the earliest compatible version that can be used for JWT authentication.

hierarchy.parent: JWT authentication and authorization for Amazon OpenSearch Service
